question.text: The variation of electric field along the $Z$-axis due to a uniformly charged circular ring of radius ' $a$ ' in $X Y$ plane is shown in the figure. The value of coordinate $M$ will be

solution.text:
For $E_{z}$ to be maximum,
$$
\frac{d E_{z}}{d z}=0 \quad \therefore z=a / \sqrt{2} \quad \text { or } \frac{z}{a}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}
$$
